sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How large can the de Sitter gradient constant c be when quintessence couples to the Standard Model and is evaluated at pion or Higgs positive-energy extrema? Can an additional scalar direction remove the observational obstruction?

sources.title: Dark Energy and the Refined de Sitter Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a scalar potential with spontaneous symmetry breaking satisfy the refined conjecture without coupling that scalar directly to quintessence? The test model combines a quartic h potential with an independent exponential φ potential.

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can a proposed quintessence escape satisfy the conjecture in a metastable QCD sector while allowing a universe in the QCD ground state to persist? The comparison fixes the Standard Model parameters across sectors.

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can a conjectured restriction on the total scalar potential constrain quark masses and the QCD angle through composite pion vacua? The paper also asks whether quintessence removes this proposed connection between quantum gravity and flavor.

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Can coupling quintessence to the entire Higgs potential avoid the extremely small gradient ratio of an additive construction near the Higgs maximum?

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Solve the sourced scalar's stationarity equation before applying the gradient conjecture. This avoids counting a removable tadpole as an independent gradient, provided the shifted branch exists, is stable and admits a controlled local expansion.

sources.title: Dark Energy and the Refined de Sitter Conjecture

evidence.text: Partition the field range, calculate sufficient derivative tests in each region, and verify overlap using the full potential. In this paper the regions are covered by negative h curvature, a large h slope, and an independent φ slope near the h minimum.

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Differentiate the constrained cosine potential, solve common-sine stationarity and classify extrema with the reduced Hessian. Its rank-one structure makes determinant positivity sufficient after imposing the subordinate-phase sign conditions.

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Combine inflationary expansion and the subsequent thermal history to solve for horizon exit. When estimating the equation of state, use the canonical oscillation coordinate and require sufficiently slow quintessence modulation; a nonlinear field redefinition changes the relevant power.

evidence.text: Translate high-energy scalar dependence into a low-energy gluonic force coefficient by integrating out heavy Standard Model thresholds. Here the two-loop term transmits a varying Higgs quartic coupling to observable QCD interactions.

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Differentiate thermal free energy, estimate scalar displacement during expansion and propagate it into a relic-density constraint. The application assumes comparable quark and gluon couplings rather than independently tuned thermal sources.

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: What protects the small quintessence potential and gradient from quantum corrections, and can a conjectural lower gradient bound explain their tuning?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional Standard Model–quintessence theory obey an order-one scalar-potential gradient bound while satisfying limits on fifth forces and varying Standard Model parameters? Can a controlled string construction realize the required selective couplings?

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How can general nonderivative interactions between quintessence and the Standard Model be parametrized while keeping the gravitational frame and scalar normalization explicit?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can a quintessence gradient grow with the electroweak potential away from the observed Higgs vacuum while avoiding direct couplings to other visible matter?

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can coupling quintessence to QCD separate the evolution of a metastable valley from that of the QCD ground-state valley enough to satisfy the SdSC without an immediate ground-state crunch?
